about.title: A marketplace for buyers and independent sellers
about.intro: Todijo is a multilingual, multi-seller marketplace where independent sellers run stores and buyers discover and order their products. Todijo is currently a pre-incorporation project; it must not be confused with an already registered Todijo SAS.

sections.title: For buyers
sections.body: Browse categories, search products, compare listing details and seller information, choose available options, order through checkout, then follow orders and message sellers from your account.

sections.title: For sellers
sections.body: Independent professional or private sellers declare their status, configure a store, publish products, manage stock and options, fulfil orders, answer messages and manage reviews and revenue.

sections.title: Todijo's role
sections.body: Todijo provides the marketplace, account, checkout, messaging and safety tools. Sellers remain responsible for their listings, products and fulfilment; applicable policies explain each party's responsibilities.

how-it-works.title: How Todijo works
how-it-works.intro: Todijo brings product discovery, seller information, checkout and order tools into one marketplace experience.

sections.title: Buying, step by step
sections.body:
1. Search or browse products.
2. Review the product and seller status.
3. Choose available variants or options.
4. Add items to your cart.
5. Complete the secure checkout.
6. Follow the order in your account.
7. Message the seller when needed.
8. Review, report or request support where available.

sections.title: Selling, step by step
sections.body:
1. Create a seller account and declare seller type.
2. Create and configure a store.
3. Add products, images, prices, options and stock.
4. Publish accurate listings.
5. Receive and fulfil orders.
6. Manage messages, reviews and revenue from the seller area.

sections.title: Clear responsibilities
sections.body: Todijo operates the platform and official checkout. Independent sellers supply and fulfil products. Buyers should review listing and seller information before ordering and keep payment and communication inside Todijo.

mission.title: A useful, accessible marketplace
mission.intro: Todijo's mission is to help independent sellers reach buyers through a clear multilingual experience, while giving buyers useful information and safer ways to transact.

sections.title: Accessible discovery
sections.body: Make products and independent stores easier to discover across languages, categories and search.

sections.title: Trust through clarity
sections.body: Show seller status, product information and marketplace rules clearly so people can make informed choices.

sections.title: Practical marketplace tools
sections.body: Provide checkout, orders, messaging, reviews and reporting tools that support real transactions without making exaggerated guarantees.

help.title: Find the right help quickly
help.intro: Choose the topic that matches what you are doing. These guides explain Todijo's current buying, selling, order and safety tools.

sections.title: Buying
sections.body: Get help with search and categories, product options, favourites, cart, checkout, orders and messages. Start with How to buy for the complete flow.

sections.title: Selling
sections.body: Learn about seller accounts and status, store setup, products, stock, orders, Stripe onboarding and the seller dashboard. The Seller guide is the detailed reference.

sections.title: Orders, account and safety
sections.body: Check order status, delivery, cancellations, returns and refunds; review privacy and cookie choices; or report a suspicious listing. Contact support when the in-app route does not cover your issue.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Use Customer support for account, seller or order help. Use Report a problem for listing, safety, payment, privacy or security concerns.

how-to-buy.title: How to buy on Todijo
how-to-buy.intro: A practical guide from finding a product to receiving support after an order.

sections.title: Discover and check
sections.body: Search or browse categories, open the product page and review its description, price, images, available stock, variants and options. Check the seller's displayed identity and professional or private status. Save favourites when signed in.

sections.title: Cart and payment
sections.body: Select the required options, add the item to your cart and review quantities and totals. Continue through Todijo's official checkout; payment processing is provided through Stripe where available. Never send card details to a seller in a message.

sections.title: After checkout
sections.body: Follow status in Account > Orders and use Todijo messages for product or fulfilment questions. After an eligible purchase, review the product. For delay, non-receipt or another problem, consult Orders and delivery, the Returns policy, or support.

how-to-sell.title: How to start selling on Todijo
how-to-sell.intro: Set up an accurate seller profile and store, publish compliant products, then manage orders through the seller area.

sections.title: Account and store
sections.body: Register as a seller, declare whether you act as a professional/trader or a private/non-professional seller, and provide the requested identity information. Create your store and keep its public profile accurate.

sections.title: Products and compliance
sections.body: Add clear images, descriptions, prices, stock and any variants or options. Provide applicable product safety, manufacturer or responsible-person information. Publish only genuine, lawful products you can fulfil.

sections.title: Orders and payments
sections.body: Complete Stripe onboarding where required, monitor orders, process and fulfil them, and communicate through Todijo. Manage messages, reviews and revenue in the dashboard. Commission rates and payout timing are not promised on this page; rely on the current account and Stripe information shown to you.

delivery.title: Understand your order journey
delivery.intro: Order timing and delivery depend on the seller and the fulfilment information for the purchase. Todijo does not promise a universal carrier or delivery time.

sections.title: From order to fulfilment
sections.body: After checkout, the order and payment state appear in the buyer and seller areas. The seller processes the order and records fulfilment or shipment details supported by the current order tools.

sections.title: Follow and communicate
sections.body: Check Account > Orders for the latest available status. Tracking is shown only when information has been provided; it is not guaranteed for every order. Use Todijo messages to ask the seller a concise question.

sections.title: Delayed or not received
sections.body: First review the status and contact the seller inside Todijo. If the issue remains, contact support with the order reference. Returns, cancellations and refunds are governed by the applicable Returns and refunds policy; compensation is not automatic.

safety.title: Buy and sell more safely
safety.intro: Good information, official payment and careful communication reduce risk. Todijo cannot guarantee zero fraud, so stay alert and report concerns.

sections.title: For buyers
sections.body: Review the listing and seller information. Pay only through Todijo's official checkout, keep messages on Todijo and do not share unnecessary personal or payment information. Report suspicious, illegal, prohibited or unsafe products.

sections.title: For sellers
sections.body: Use accurate listings, genuine products, current stock and applicable safety information. Keep buyer communication on Todijo, protect account credentials and refuse requests for off-platform payment or secret codes.

sections.title: Protect your account
sections.body: Use a strong, unique password and never share passwords, full card numbers or authentication codes. Treat urgent requests to move payment or communication elsewhere as suspicious, and contact support for privacy or security concerns.

seller-guide.title: The Todijo seller guide
seller-guide.intro: A practical reference for setting up, operating and protecting an independent store on Todijo.

sections.title: Getting established
sections.body: Create a seller account, declare professional/trader or private/non-professional status, configure the store profile and provide accurate identity and professional details. Add VAT information only where applicable to you.

sections.title: Build trustworthy listings
sections.body: Use accurate titles, descriptions and images; set prices, stock, variants and options; and provide required product safety, manufacturer and responsible-person details. Follow Marketplace rules and Seller terms.

sections.title: Run the store
sections.body: Monitor and fulfil orders, keep buyers informed through Todijo messages, handle reviews and applicable return/refund requests, and report disputes through available support routes. Complete Stripe onboarding for payment services and review revenue in the dashboard; no fixed payout schedule is promised here.

sections.title: Protect the account
sections.body: Keep credentials private, review privacy and cookie controls, and maintain accurate store and seller information. Use support for access, payment, security or reporting problems.

contact.title: Choose the right contact route
contact.intro: Todijo currently provides written support through its verified support channel. No phone line, physical office, live chat or response-time guarantee is claimed.

sections.title: Orders and buying
sections.body: Check the Help centre, Orders and delivery, and Returns policy first. If you still need help, email support with the order reference and a concise description.

sections.title: Sellers and stores
sections.body: Use the Seller guide for setup, products, orders and Stripe onboarding. Contact support for an account-specific issue that the dashboard does not resolve.

sections.title: Privacy, safety and general help
sections.body: Use the Privacy & Data page for GDPR requests. Use Report a problem for unsafe or illegal listings, account/payment concerns or security issues. General questions can use the support email below.

support.title: Help us understand your issue
support.intro: Send a clear written request through Todijo's verified support email. Support availability is not advertised as 24/7 and no fixed response time is promised.

sections.title: What to include
sections.body: Provide the email linked to your account, the order reference when relevant, a concise description, and useful screenshots or evidence. Mention what you already tried.

sections.title: Keep secrets private
sections.body: Never send your password, full payment-card number, security code or one-time authentication code. Todijo support does not need these secrets to investigate an issue.

sections.title: Use the quickest route
sections.body: Consult the Help centre for guidance. For a listing or safety concern, use the product-page reporting action where available or follow Report a problem. For privacy rights, use Privacy & Data.

report-problem.title: Report a problem safely
report-problem.intro: Use the existing in-app reporting action when it matches the issue; otherwise send a focused report through Todijo support. A separate duplicate reporting system is not required.

sections.title: Product or listing
sections.body: On a published product page, signed-in users can report an illegal, unsafe, misleading, prohibited or other listing problem. Use that action so the report is attached to the correct product.

sections.title: Order, seller or account
sections.body: For an order or seller issue, first keep relevant messages and order details, then contact support with the order reference. Use support for payment or account-access problems; do not email passwords or full card information.

sections.title: Privacy or security
sections.body: For a privacy-rights request or personal-data concern, use the Privacy & Data route and support email. For an urgent security concern, clearly label the issue and include only necessary evidence.
